# netbox_circuit_group_assignment (Data Source)

Retrieves a single circuit group assignment from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_circuit_group_assignment" "example" {
  id       = 1
  group_id = 1
}

output "circuit_group_assignment_id" {
  value = data.netbox_circuit_group_assignment.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_id` (Number) The ID of the group associated with the circuit group assignment.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the circuit group assignment.
- `member_type` (String) The member type of the circuit group assignment.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) The created of the circuit group assignment.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the circuit group assignment, as a map of field name to value.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the circuit group assignment.
- `member` (String) The member of the circuit group assignment.
- `member_id` (Number) The member id of the circuit group assignment.
- `priority` (String) The priority of the circuit group assignment.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
